required_equivalence.transfer_rule: If source formula and all candidate orders match v2 exactly, every previously measured exact caterpillar PS-width for those orders transfers identically; no repeated exponential PS probe is scientifically necessary.

exact_incremental_identities.edge_pressure: cross(S union {u}) = cross(S) + deg(u) - 2*|N(u) intersect S|
exact_incremental_identities.semantic_pressure_state: Maintain counts of directed crossing group pairs (group(selected endpoint), group(outside endpoint)).
semantic_trial_delta: for neighbor v already in S: decrement (group(v), group(u))
for neighbor v outside S: increment (group(u), group(v))
exact_incremental_identities.semantic_frontier: number of group-pair counters with positive count

complexity_contract.r: number of incidence leaves = variables + clauses
complexity_contract.e: number of incidence edges = total literal occurrences
complexity_contract.one_trial_candidate: O(deg(u)) local edge/group-pair work plus O(1) scalar pressure updates
complexity_contract.one_round_all_remaining: O(e) incident-edge visits up to a constant factor because sum of remaining degrees <= 2e
complexity_contract.one_structured_front: O(r*e) incident-edge visits plus polynomial ordering overhead
complexity_contract.eight_structured_fronts: O(r*e) up to frozen constant factor 8
complexity_contract.exploration_fronts: linear leaf permutations with fixed count 8

accounting_rule: shared source incidence index is built and charged once per formula
every neighbor membership test and group-pair delta is charged
trace arithmetic and candidate comparison-key evaluation are charged
no exact PS audit cost is mixed into producer generation cost
